name: stream-chat
description: Full-stack real-time chat and video meeting app.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: npm run build:widget && concurrently --names "BE,FE,WIDGET" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start:lan --prefix frontend" "node frontend/node_modules/.bin/http-server frontend/dist/widget/browser -p 4500 -c-1 --cors --ssl --ssl-key certs/server.key --ssl-cert certs/server.crt"
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:widget && concurrently --names "BE,FE,WIDGET" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "node frontend/node_modules/.bin/http-server frontend/dist/widget/browser -p 4500 -c-1 --cors --ssl --ssl-key certs/server.key --ssl-cert certs/server.crt"
